<parameter=code>

def btok(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'bS' and 4<=n['pixels']<=40:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
